ModMetaData.description: Test harness for Old Scores (nahuel.oldscores). Only does something under `rw launch --ticks N` (command-line arg -rwtools-ticks): from tick 2700 it drives the three features through real kills, captures, raids, exits and the queued incident, and logs [Test] PASS/FAIL lines. Not for normal play.
